topic: How a Bloom filter rejects a missing key

plan.title: How a Bloom filter rejects a missing key

sources.title: Bloom filter
sources.excerpt: A Bloom filter is a space-efficient probabilistic data structure, conceived by Burton Howard Bloom in 1970, that is used to test whether an element is a member of a set. False positive matches are possible, but false negatives are not.
